summary: Read-only initial catalog and platform assessment. No source, plugin, deployment or live configuration changed. Connected Jarvis catalog exposes 130 actions. Current checkout main d702352ef705f9991ac1cb14dc15a13cce78aa44, clean, but remote HEAD was not independently verified. Program.fs:100-105 registers one JarvisMcpTools class with stateless HTTP and device-routing call filter; McpEndpoint.fs:40 maps authenticated /mcp. plugin/mcp.json points at that endpoint. Plugin Creator's existing-server/package guidance supports separate plugin packages pointing to a verified MCP endpoint, but does not establish per-action filtering or simultaneous duplicate connections. Therefore do not claim focused discovery works by packaging alone. No platform discovery/overlap equivalence or before/after evaluation has been executed.
